user_query: I would like to compare the exponential moving averages of multiple stocks. Fetch the 24-hour trading data for various markets to identify potential investment opportunities. Also, provide me with the balance sheet of NVIDIA Corporation to assess their financial performance.

TaskList.description: Fetch 24-hour trading data for multiple stocks across various markets to analyze the latest market trends.
Calculate the exponential moving averages (EMAs) for the fetched trading data of the selected stocks.
Fetch the balance sheet information of NVIDIA Corporation to review its financial performance.
Analyze the balance sheet data of NVIDIA Corporation in conjunction with the EMA analysis to identify investment opportunities.
